linkedin.text:
🚨 You're clicking through fifty CapCut projects to update the same subtitle style.

Here's the truth nobody mentions: CapCut stores every project as local JSON. One file holds your timeline, clips, effects, captions, and export settings.

capcut-cli reads and writes that JSON directly — no GUI, no API, no server.

✅ Batch-generate captions with Whisper
✅ Translate subtitles across twenty projects in one command
✅ Script any repetitive edit: trim, speed, volume, transitions, effects

It's designed so Claude, GPT, or any automation can drive it. JSON in, JSON out. Zero dependencies.

⭐ 246 stars prove developers are cutting hours off subtitle and template workflows.

Next time you face batch edits, script it instead of clicking.

Search GitHub for "renezander030/capcut-cli" and see the full command reference.

What's the most repetitive CapCut task you wish you could automate?
